stop.0.blurb: Magac iyo hab aad dib ugu soo noqoto. Halkan looma baahna inaad caddeyso inaad u qalanto codeyn — degganaansho kaliya ayaa ah shuruudda.
stop.0.title: Sameyso akoonkaaga
stop.1.blurb: Dooro goob ama door shacab, ka dibna u gudub bulshada, shaqada, ama waxbarashada.
stop.1.title: Sahmi adduunka
stop.10.blurb: Farriimaha tooska ah iyo kuwa kooxda — waa qarsoodi, sida warqadda codeynta.
stop.10.title: Farriimaha
stop.11.blurb: Ururi saxiixyada si su'aal loogu soo bandhigo qof kasta.
stop.11.title: Codsiyada
stop.12.blurb: Halkaan goobtu ay iskula hadasho — xadhigyada ku xidhan hindisayaasha sharciga, musharraxnimada iyo codsiyada horteeda yaalla.
stop.12.title: Hoolalka
stop.13.blurb: Fagaaraha ku kooban hal xuduud awoodeed: diiwaan furan oo isku mid ah, balse halkan kaliya ku saabsan.
stop.13.title: Wadaagga goobta — fagaaraha
stop.14.blurb: Markhaati lagu xiri karo diiwaanka joogtada ah — hadal noqonaya caddayn.
stop.14.title: Wadaagga goobta — hoolalka
stop.15.title: Doorasho
stop.16.blurb: Wejiga ansixinta — si aamusnaan ah u ansixiy dadka aad rabto inay ku jiraan warqadda codeynta.
stop.16.title: Warqadda codeynta furan
stop.17.blurb: Kala horeysii doorashooyinkaaga — kursiyada waxaa loo qaybiyaa si caddaalad ah, codna lama khasaariyo.
stop.17.title: Warqadda codeynta kala horeysiin
stop.18.blurb: Tirinta, wareeg waraeg — daawo codadka ilaa kursi kasta la buuxiyo.
stop.18.title: Natiijooyinka
stop.19.blurb: Haddii aad halkaas deggan tahay, waad musharraxmi kartaa — taasi waa shuruudda kaliya.
stop.19.title: U tartan xafiiska
stop.2.blurb: Waxa hadda dhacaya, iyo waxa aad ku tallaabi karto.
stop.2.title: Hoyga
stop.20.blurb: Xisbiyada, ganacsiyada, ururrada aan macaash doonka ahayn — hal diiwaan oo furan, oo aanay jirin mashiinnada xisbiyada.
stop.20.title: Ururrada
stop.21.blurb: Kiis kasta waa diiwaan dadweyne — guddiyo garsooreyaal ah, xeerbeegtiyada degganayaasha ah.
stop.21.title: Liiska kiisaska
stop.22.blurb: Diiwaanka dadweyne ee joogtada ah — si qarsoodi ah looma wax ka beddeli karo.
stop.22.title: Diiwaannada dadweynaha
stop.23.blurb: Go'aan kasta, oo xiran silsilad hash ah — adigu xaqiiji.
stop.23.title: Silsiladda hanti-dhowrka
stop.24.blurb: Dastuurka waxaa wax laga beddelaa laba waddo oo kaliya — labaduba waa furan yihiin.
stop.24.title: Wax-ka-beddelka
stop.25.blurb: Kala-xaajiska, waqtiga kama dambaysta ah, iyo xadka bilaaba hannaanka iyada oo aan cidna weydiisan.
stop.25.title: Saacadaha
stop.26.blurb: Cillad, su'aal, ama wax u baahan dib-u-eegis — halkan ku gudbi.
stop.26.title: Sheeg dhibaatada
stop.27.blurb: Xadka dadka muhiimka ah iyo tallaabooyinka hawlgalinta ee toddobada ah ee meeshaa noolaynaya.
stop.27.title: Sida meeshu u soo toosto
stop.28.blurb: Sida meeluhu ugu midoobaan mid — iyadoo loo marayo aqlabiyad gaar ah oo laba-laab ah, iyadoo ku biirista iyo ka bixistu ay yihiin nuqul muraayad.
stop.28.title: Samaynta midowga
stop.29.blurb: Codbixiyeyaashu waxay isku geeyaan hal heer, waxayna sii wadaan inay ismaamulaan.
stop.29.title: Ka saarista heerka dhexe
stop.3.blurb: Noloshaada madaniga ah hal meel — degganaanshaha, codadka aad bixisay (laakiin aan waligii lagu sheegin sida), iyo ficilladaada dadweynaha.
stop.3.title: Diiwaankayga
stop.30.blurb: Silsiladda soo celinta, dhibcaha sharciyadda, iyo difaaca meesha dib loo soo celiyay.
stop.30.title: Dib-u-dhiska dawlad lumay
stop.31.blurb: Federaalka, xuduudaha oo lagu go'aamiyay aqlabiyad gaar ah, iyo sida tusaalouhu u ahaadaan hal adduun.
stop.31.title: Inta u dhaxaysa dawladaha
stop.32.blurb: Saami yar oo aan shuruud lahayn oo loogu abaalmariyo ka qaybgalka — oo la siiyo dadka, ee aan waligii lagu shubin akoonnada.
stop.32.title: Lacagta gunta madaniga ah
stop.33.blurb: Heshiis kasta wuxuu leeyahay shuruudo hoose — fur mid si aad u aragto saxiixyada iyo heshiiska.
stop.33.title: Heshiisyada
stop.34.blurb: Guulaha madaniga ah ee ugu horreeya, socodka hagidda ah, iyo guulaha meesha, oo lagu xiray diiwaan kaliya wax lagu kordhin karo.
stop.34.title: Guulaha
stop.35.blurb: Lacagtaada, suuqa furan, iyo maaliyadda dadweynaha — dhaqaalaha oo dhan hal meel.
stop.35.title: Suuqa
stop.36.blurb: Waxa aad haysato iyo waxa dhaqaaqay — waa kuu gaar, sida warqadda codeynta.
stop.36.title: Boorsadayda
stop.37.blurb: Dalabyada iyo codsiyada u dhexeeya dadka — suuq laba dhinac leh, oo si furan lagu xalliyo.
stop.37.title: Suuqa furan
stop.38.blurb: Waxa ay tahay unugga iyo sida lacagta loo soo saaro — waa waxa abstract ah, oo aan lahayn waddooyin lacag bixineed.
stop.38.title: Unugyada & lacagta
stop.39.blurb: Khasnadada meesha, oo furan — waxa soo galay, waxa baxay, iyo sababta.
stop.39.title: Maaliyadda dadweynaha
stop.4.blurb: Baro adigoo samaynaya — safar kasta wuxuu raacaa hal geedi-socod oo dhab ah; marka aad mid dhammaystirto wuxuu galaa profile-kaaga.
stop.4.title: Safarrada
stop.40.blurb: Akoonnada wadaaga ah ee dhaqaaqa kaliya marka ay dadka wadaaga ah isku raacaan.
stop.40.title: Diiwaannada wadajirka ah
stop.41.blurb: Marka ay shaqaaluhu dhaafaan xad cayiman, shaqaaluhu waxay doorasho ku helaan kursi guddiga maamulka — iyadoo la isticmaalayo isla tirinta caddaaladda ah.
stop.41.title: Kursiga shaqaalaha ee guddiga maamulka
stop.42.blurb: Sida ururku u beddelmo gacmaha ama u beddelmo nooca — tallaabo kasta waxay ku jirtaa diiwaanka.
stop.42.title: Beddelka lahaanshaha
stop.43.blurb: Beddel halka aad deggan tahay, xuquuqdaaduna way ku raacayaan — degganaanshaha ayaa ah furaha kaliya.
stop.43.title: U guur meel cusub
stop.44.blurb: Sababta muddada madaniga ah iyo tan garsoorka ay isku mar u socdaan — toban sano, oo is-waafaqsan.
stop.44.title: Muddada oo isla mar dhammaata
stop.45.blurb: Immisa qof ayaa qayb qaatay — qiyaas lagu cabbiro, ee ma aha qalab lagu xukumo.
stop.45.title: Gaadhista
stop.46.blurb: Wax kasta oo aad gudbisay iyo halka ay tageen — cilad, su'aal, ama codsi dib-u-eegis ah.
stop.46.title: Warbixinnadaada
stop.47.blurb: Waxa horey loo dhisay, waxa weli imaanaya, iyo sida aad nooga sheegi lahayd halka ay ku liidato.
stop.47.title: Helitaanka
stop.48.blurb: Go'aannada naqshadaynta ee dadku ugu weydiiyaan, kuwaas oo lagu jawaabay iyadoo loo eegayo Template-ka.
stop.48.title: Su'aalaha adag
stop.49.blurb: Dib u eeg caafimaadka node-kan oo furi xakamaynta martigelinta.
stop.49.title: Dulmarka martigelinta
stop.5.blurb: Sharraxaado luqad fudud ah oo ku saabsan sida wax kastaan u shaqeeyaan. Akhrisku waxba kuma kusto, waxna ku furayo — aqoontu ma aha shuruud.
stop.5.title: Baro
stop.50.blurb: Sida node-ka looga gaaro shabakadda, iyo sida uu u xaqiijiyo inuu yahay isaga dhabta ah.
stop.50.title: DNS & shahaadooyinka
stop.51.blurb: Ka saarista kaliya ee loo ogol yahay — afar xaaladood oo kooban, waligood ma aha aragti.
stop.51.title: Kormeerka & heerka sharciga
stop.52.blurb: Dadka lagu kalsoon yahay ee maamula mashiinka — waa su'aal ka madax-bannaan qofka xafiiska haya, mana siinayso wax awood ah.
stop.52.title: Yaa maamula node-kan
stop.53.blurb: Instance-yada kale ee uu kan la kulmay, iyo waxa uu ka aqbalo iyaga.
stop.53.title: Mesh-ka
stop.54.blurb: Sida node-kan u xaqiijiyo inuu yahay isaga, iyo sida uu u aqoonsado deriskiisa.
stop.54.title: Aqoonsiga & furayaasha
stop.55.blurb: Code-ka uu node-kan ku shaqaynayo — hal adduun wuxuu ku fidi karaa noocyo kala duwan, markaa waa inuu ahaadaa mid la akhrin karo.
stop.55.title: Noocyada & casriyeynta
stop.56.blurb: Nuqullada kaydsan, safafka, iyo shaqooyinka saacadda wareejiyo.
stop.56.title: Hawlgallada maalin laha ah
stop.57.blurb: Isku-xidhka, Kalsoonida Buuxda & Aqoonsiga, iyo instance-ka u xil-leh wax kasta.
stop.57.title: Konsoolka federaalka
stop.58.blurb: Guddi ayaa ku kulma fadhi furan — qof kasta waa daawan karaa, degganayaashu way markhaati furi karaan, kalmad kastaana waxay geliyaa diiwaanka joogtada ah. Guddoomiyaha ayaa maamula qolka; nidaamka ayaa maamula xafiisyada.
stop.58.title: Dhageysiga tooska ah ee guddiga
stop.6.blurb: Degganaanshaha goobta ayaa ah shuruudda kaliya ee xuquuq kasta halkan.
stop.6.title: Sheeg halka aad deggan tahay
stop.7.blurb: Meel kasta oo dhulka ah, laga bilaabo meeraha ilaa xaafadda — mid kastaa ismaamul ayay leedahay.
stop.7.title: Goobaha
stop.8.blurb: Qol kasta, oo lagu xaddiday dadka — kursiyadu waxay raacaan dadka.
stop.8.title: Golaha sharci-dejinta
stop.9.blurb: Hadal furan oo ku jira diiwaan dadweyne — qofna si qarsoodi ah uga saari karo.
stop.9.title: Fagaaraha dadweynaha
